cases.name: current-key-valid
cases.why: The current release key, inside its validity window.

cases.name: previous-key-before-rotation
cases.why: The retired key verifies an index it signed while it was valid: history stays checkable after rotation.

cases.name: previous-key-after-rotation
cases.why: A retired key outside its window. Rotation is expressed in allowed_signers, not by deleting the line.

cases.name: current-key-before-its-window
cases.why: valid-after is enforced as strictly as valid-before.

cases.name: tampered-index
cases.why: One changed byte in the index; the signature no longer covers it.

cases.name: unknown-signer
cases.why: A well-formed signature by a key allowed_signers does not list.

cases.name: wrong-namespace
cases.why: A signature made for another purpose by the right key must not be replayed as an index signature.

cases.name: no-signature
cases.why: No index.json.sig at all: unsigned, distinct from a signature that fails.
